scenes.headline: How a 12-frame memory tracks a long drive
scenes.sub: Streaming 3D reconstruction that chains local predictions
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Odometer! This model reconstructs very long videos while remembering only the last few frames.

scenes.text: Ask the network only for things that look the same at frame 10 and frame 10,000, then chain them into a trajectory.
scenes.say: Ask only for things that never get harder as the video grows: a point map in the current camera, and one step of motion.

steps.say: A new frame attends to the cached keys and values of the eleven frames before it. Older ones are thrown away.
The decoder predicts a point map in the current camera's own coordinates.
A camera head predicts one relative pose, from this frame to the last one.
Multiplying the steps together gives the global path, and the point maps follow it.

scenes.title: Which past frames a frame can see

steps.label: full cache
steps.say: A full causal cache keeps every past frame, so memory grows with the video.

steps.label: 12-frame window
steps.say: ABot-Recon keeps a band of twelve, so every frame solves the same sized problem.

scenes.label: keys and values for one frame, across 18 layers
scenes.note: 232 GiB for KITTI-02 if nothing were evicted
scenes.say: Each frame's cache is about fifty-one mebibytes. A whole driving sequence would need over two hundred gibibytes.

scenes.title: What makes a pose chain drift

left.title: Step length error
left.say: A wrong step length is one wrong step. In my toy, five percent noise cost about two metres.

right.title: Heading error
right.say: A wrong heading bends everything after it. A tiny twist per step cost thirteen metres.

scenes.title: Two fixes for drift
scenes.say: The paper attacks drift without widening the window.

items.say: Training composes predicted poses over gaps up to eleven frames and grades the product.
A small refiner uses recent motion and the images to nudge each rotation.
An optional pose graph pulls the path back on revisits.

scenes.title: KITTI average ATE, same window
scenes.say: Grading chains halved the error on KITTI. Longer clips and the refiner took it to about eighteen metres.

scenes.text: Bounded memory came from choosing local targets, then training hard on how they compose.
scenes.say: The memory bound came from the targets, not a clever cache.
Twelve frames of memory, local predictions, and a chain trained to hold together.
